campaign_allowance.explanation: Bounds cover the frozen campaign including setup, warm-ups, grading and reporting. They are reservation ceilings, not measured consumption or execution approval. budget_preview.explanation: Counts adapter model turns, not internal inference steps. Full planned trials exclude planning, warm-ups and retries.
